acceptance: Thin, elongated attack trajectory, lower sweeping blade and tapered rising right tip
Two separate motion phases: luminous blade frames 0-5, fragmented elemental remnants frames 6-11
Each element uses its own particles and color palette, never a generic recolored ring
V1 and V2 sprites byte-for-byte unchanged
V5 is original 144px indexed transparent PNG with 12 frames, 16fps
Phaser WebGL gallery has independent controls for Ver golpe (frame4) and Ver fragmentos (frame7)
No release or Pokemon Torre 2 changes without visual approval
V5.1 changes only the optional lab rendering: five independent layer objects with one subtle ADD glow batch and original V5 rollback control
All opaque layer pixels must reconstruct original V5 exactly; glow is an overlay limited to original core highlight pixels
V5.2 glints must be <50 pixels in frame 4, visible only frames 3-7, without thickening original core.
Runtime adjusts opacity of core-adjacent layers and breakup by frame; original V5.1 render remains accessible.
V5.3 six original material shapes are sparse (only frames 3–7), not generic recolored rings; none of the previous PNGs may be changed.
The variable per-frame timing must be synchronized for all 7 Phaser layers and only enabled in V5.3; dark/light/battle backgrounds are test fixtures.
